representative_rule: Select exactly one assay midpoint nearest the median measured depth of every frozen 5 m physical-hole group; retain its pre-existing contiguous spatial-block label and do not export mine coordinates.
simulation_point_count_policy: All eligible physical-hole groups; no point may be removed based on a simulated result.
reporting_policy: Retain every scenario, replicate, method and fallback; report pooled, fold, far-quartile and paired-delta results.
